description: This file declares functions related to generating boot configuration arguments from a Cuttlefish configuration, including functions to produce argument maps and strings.

methods.name: BootconfigArgsFromConfig
methods.description: Generates a map of boot configuration arguments based on the provided Cuttlefish configuration and its specific instance.

methods.name: BootconfigArgsString
methods.description: Converts a map of arguments into a single string separated by the specified separator.
